description: Batch K-line for multiple securities from one market (A-shares or HK `HK:00000`, do not mix markets in one batch) in one round-trip. Daily bars default to date desc (HK daily bars are unadjusted); use order=asc for chronological calculations. Response sort echoes the date order. Daily: ≤100 codes × ≤1 yr; minute: ≤20 codes × ≤7 d. Envelope: `{items:[{canonical_code, bars}], errors:[{canonical_code, error_code, message}]}`. ⚠️ Read `errors[]` first: an unknown code lands there as `unknown_security`, while a real security with no trading in the window returns an empty `bars[]` — report that as no data, not a bad code.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

minute.description: Minute-level bars instead of daily (tighter caps apply)

order.description: Daily bar date order (default desc); minute bars are always ascending

name: bars_batch
